name: Intent-Certified Semantic Lowering
upstream: CLAY-L4 L0 Intent -> L1 Canonical Clay boundary
purpose: Compile partially specified human/agent intent into explicit canonical Clay obligations without converting ambiguity, preference or authority references into truth/execution authority; then lower into existing CBCC/COVE basis, closure, projection and capability semantics.

state_contracts.invariant: probabilistic extraction/proposal only; lexical content and L2 model fluency do not grant fact or authority
binds evidence to exact proposal; compiler/type/hash validity is not semantic adequacy; adequacy is not execution authority
committed executable meaning; authority requirements are dependencies to verify, not minted capabilities

operations.rule: preserve source-span grounding and UNKNOWN rather than forced completion

operations.executor: deterministic checks + external/domain/user/owner/test evidence as available
operations.rule: semantic adequacy evidence is typed by source and coverage; unknown remains first-class

preconditions: adequacy receipt bound to exact proposal

effect_tiering.READ_ONLY: PARTIAL adequacy may be allowed when all unresolved clauses are non-effect-critical and no protected truth/authority mutation occurs
effect_tiering.REVERSIBLE: policy may allow PARTIAL only with bounded recovery and no effect-critical unknown
effect_tiering.IRREVERSIBLE: requires VERIFIED adequacy for effect-critical clauses plus ordinary current external capability/authority checks at release

claygraph_mapping.raw_intent: external/quoted provenance-bearing source, not canonical fact
claygraph_mapping.intent_contract: committed semantic contract with source/adequacy ancestry
claygraph_mapping.model_native_symbols: versioned CLAY_MODEL projection only; never canonical truth by frequency/purity

gwt_mapping: IntentContract/view identity is an upstream causal witness; workspace experiments must pin or independently vary it rather than bundling intent reinterpretation with selection.
hyperposition_mapping: language layer + semantic class participate in firebreak identity; no implicit authority-amplifying cross-layer cast.
emergence_mapping: recurrent intent/contracts/native symbols are not emergence evidence; E-CERT2 remains required.
reader_boundary: Canonical S.INTENT_CONTRACT is not necessarily optimal CLAY_MODEL surface. Reader projection remains versioned and independently benchmarked.
evidence_boundary: Reference implementation + synthetic/Judge0 mechanism tests + Groq 8B proxy + independent 2026 external intent-compilation/effect-typed agent literature. No target-Qwen/live-FRANK promotion.
